claims.summary: The release is driven by a live EduTool.dev environmental-science package where requested deliverable labels became lesson concepts while the package still reported 99/A.
Course-map readiness repair rejects prompt artifact labels as topic candidates for normal disciplinary courses and rewrites contaminated cells from the real lesson topic.
The Crucible grader scores prompt artifact contamination as a package defect, escalating multi-label Course Map contamination to P0.
Regression coverage pins both the repair layer and the package-grader layer, including the instructional-design false-positive guard.
The release boundary keeps the CourseIR one-call architecture behind its existing live side-by-side proof gates while this patch hardens the shipped path.

carryForward.next: Run deployed side-by-side 5-, 8-, and 15-lesson CourseIR comparisons before making CourseIR generation the default.
